title: Paneer and Avocado Coconut Curry
description: A creamy and sweet curry made with paneer, avocado, and coconut, featuring a nutty flavor and hints of banana sweetness.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the nutty spice mix and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the paneer cubes and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced avocado and cook for another 2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the sliced banana and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot.
